description: Reverse ASIN on Amazon (11 marketplaces): the observed head search terms where a product appeared on page 1 (organic rank, or a sponsored unit in the page), dated, organic first. Pass asins (up to 10, yours first) to compare with competitors: each keyword shows every competitor's rank, asins_on_page, and gap=true where a competitor is on page 1 and the first product is not; gaps_only=true keeps only those. Coverage is head search terms and page 1 only (the coverage block gives the counts), so a product shows fewer keywords than a full search index would. Not volume figures. The 11 Amazon marketplaces (marketplace_id; US default).

asin.description: One ASIN. Use asins to compare.

asins.description: Up to 10 ASINs, the product first, then its competitors.

gaps_only.description: With asins: only keywords where a competitor is on page 1 and the first product is not.

marketplace_id.description: 2 = Amazon US (default), 1 = UK, 6 = DE, 4 = CA, 5 = AU, 9 = FR, 8 = IT, 10 = ES, 7 = JP, 11 = MX, 12 = BR: the marketplaces the search-position map covers (all but US and UK since 2026-10-30, still filling in).

name: asin_keywords
